pages.text: A small echo you can carry. It stores no aether itself, but tells the flow where your jars have gone.

pages.title: Follow the branches from home
pages.text: Use it on a connected resonator to remember the entire tree. Carry the receiver and jars in your inventory or offhand to recharge within any connected branch.$(br2)Unbuilt paths cannot answer. Charge your jars before travelling; a branch also shares its bandwidth with other devices.

pages.title: Later, leave yourself a path home
pages.text: With crystalline material, make a personal anchor and rebind here. Within the same world, supply no longer depends on resonance coverage.$(br2)To cross between worlds, fit a Worldbinding Eye to the anchor. Rebinding to another tree or anchor remembers that new path.
